name: Benchtop Lab Pipette Liquid Automaton
title: Benchtop Lab Pipette Liquid Automaton
tagline: Dual-bay 96-well SBS microplate indexer + MGN9H linear rail XY gantry + T8 leadscrew pipette plunger escapement
description: Entry-level benchtop 96-well plate pipetting robots and automated serial-dilution workstations cost $590–$3,500+. This DIY open-labware alternative pairs 8 precision PETG/PLA+ structural gantry & compliant pipette clamp STLs with MGN9H linear rails, NEMA17 stepper motors, a T8 anti-backlash leadscrew, and a 3-axis ESP32 GRBL controller for $68.50 total.
summary: Entry-level benchtop 96-well plate pipetting robots and automated serial-dilution workstations cost $590–$3,500+. This DIY open-labware alternative pairs 8 precision PETG/PLA+ structural gantry & compliant pipette clamp STLs with MGN9H linear rails, NEMA17 stepper motors, a T8 anti-backlash leadscrew, and a 3-axis ESP32 GRBL controller for $68.50 total.
functionSummary: Indexes across standard SBS 96-well microplates (9.0mm well pitch) along MGN9H stainless linear rails while actuating a standard single- or 8-channel micropipette plunger via a T8×2mm pitch leadscrew for automated serial dilutions and reagent dispensing.

keyMechanisms: Kinematic SBS 96-well microplate registration deck with 9.00mm pitch datum pins for source and target plates
MGN9H stainless steel linear rail X/Y portal gantry driven by GT2 6mm timing belts and 20T aluminum pulleys (0.0125mm microstep resolution)
Compliant Z-axis micropipette barrel cradle with T8×2mm anti-backlash leadscrew plunger actuator (~0.2µL resolution)
Passive end-of-travel tip stripping fork and 3-axis ESP32 GRBL controller with silent TMC2209 stepper drivers

engineeringNotes: Print PRT-01 (96-Well Indexing Deck) and PRT-02/03 (Gantry Uprights) in PETG with 4 perimeters and 35% cubic infill for dimensional stability.
MGN9H rail mounting ledges include a 0.15mm reference shoulder to guarantee X/Y orthogonality without dial-indicator tramming.
Packs across 2 build plates on a Bambu Lab A1 (256×256mm bed): Plate 1 holds the 96-well deck + electronics housing + small carriages; Plate 2 holds the left/right portal uprights and Z-cradle.
materialsNeeded: PETG Filament (~342g) for 96-well SBS deck, left/right gantry uprights, MGN9H shuttle, Z-pipette cradle & tip ejector
PLA+ Filament (~58g) for T8 plunger escapement arm & vented ESP32 GRBL controller enclosure
3× NEMA17 Steppers + 2× MGN9H 250mm Linear Rails + T8 Leadscrew + GT2 Belt Kit + ESP32 GRBL TMC2209 Board
